purpose: Validate whether explicit direct/coupled target evidence, exogenous nuisance diagnosis, independently estimated observation support, and protected random audit improve real insect-visit observation without conflating non-detection with biological absence.

biological_event.source: synchronised independent reference observation, annotated without primary-stream algorithm outputs or primary-stream support labels
biological_event.visit_definition: operational interaction event at the focal floral target; does not imply pollination effectiveness
biological_event.hard_rule: If the reference truth channel cannot resolve the biological state, the window is truth_unresolved and cannot be relabelled no_insect.

target_coupled_response.source: separate reference-channel causal-attribution pass after biological state annotation; primary-stream target/nuisance/support outputs hidden
target_coupled_response.definition: local response causally attributable to focal insect contact/visit; exogenous wind/background motion is excluded
hard_rules: resolved present coupling requires resolved target_contact or visit_event biological truth
if causal attribution to the insect cannot be supported, coupling truth is unresolved rather than present
target-coupled response is never stored as exogenous nuisance truth

nuisance.source: separate primary-stream annotation/physical-log pass with reference biological truth and algorithm outputs hidden
nuisance.hard_rule: Target-driven local flower response is not nuisance merely because it is motion.

observation_support.source: separate primary-stream support pass with reference biological truth, nuisance labels, and algorithm outputs hidden
observation_support.question: If a visit occurred in the focal interaction zone, was the primary system-under-test stream sufficient to observe it?
observation_support.independence_rule: Primary-stream support is not derived from target score, nuisance score, biological truth or reference-channel visibility.

layer_blinding_contract.coupling_truth_ledger: reference stream causal-attribution pass; target/nuisance/support algorithm outputs hidden
layer_blinding_contract.nuisance_truth_ledger: primary stream only; biological reference truth hidden
layer_blinding_contract.support_truth_ledger: primary stream only; biological reference truth and nuisance labels hidden
layer_blinding_contract.join_key: window_id plus channel-specific clip SHA-256 provenance

target_route_contract.coupled_route: evidence for target-linked local response, retained separately from direct evidence
target_route_contract.aggregate_use: an aggregate target score may be used operationally, but V15 evaluation preserves direct and coupled route scores
target_route_contract.nuisance_independence: exogenous nuisance observer outputs are not inputs to the target-route calculation

reference_truth_contract.primary_stream: the camera stream evaluated by the target/nuisance/support algorithms
reference_truth_contract.reference_stream: a synchronised observation channel used only for biological/coupling truth and never as model input
reference_truth_contract.both_streams_unresolved: biological truth is unresolved; exclude from biological accuracy denominators but retain for support/QC accounting

split_contract.development: measurement calibration and contradiction-guided failure diagnosis only
split_contract.held_out: entirely new recording days and focal scenes/flowers
forbidden: random frame split across the same recording block
held-out tuning after observer output inspection
counting frames as independent biological replicates

primary_questions: Can O be estimated from primary-stream measurement properties without target/nuisance outputs or truth?
Does explicit observability censoring reduce false absence compared with treating low target evidence as absence?
Does exogenous nuisance information identify false-positive/miss-risk conditions that target evidence alone cannot diagnose?
Can target-coupled local flower response rescue real visits when direct insect evidence is weak?
Does preserving coupling separately avoid falsely relabelling exogenous flower/background motion as insect evidence?
Does the protected probability sample recover visits or observation failures missed by all targeted components?
Does the full system preserve a more defensible visit-rate denominator than targeted-only sampling?

development_contract.rule: after independent truth join, representation/model defects may modify exactly one subsystem while siblings remain frozen
development_contract.stop: contradiction-type saturation rather than zero disagreement

forbidden: universal superiority of the full system
universal validity of indirect flower-response evidence

freeze_rule: Before held-out scoring, sample-size/power plan, O measurement/calibration rule, target/nuisance development calibration, final metric formulas, coupling annotation rule, cluster/exposure-time estimator and claim thresholds must be committed and hashed.
